title: The wrong version, on the same nested payload
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun sumAll(v) = v match {
  case o is Object -> sum(o pluck ((value) -> if (value is Number) value else 0))
  case a is Array -> sum(a map ((item) -> if (item is Number) item else 0))
  else -> 0
}
---
sumAll(payload)

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun sumAll(v) = v match {
  case o is Object -> sum(o pluck ((value) -> if (value is Number) value else 0))
  case a is Array -> sum(a map ((item) -> if (item is Number) item else 0))
  else -> 0
}
---
sumAll(payload)

explanation.approach: Nothing is directly a Number inside the top-level Object — `a` is an Object and `d` and `e` are not numbers — so this version reports 0 for a payload whose numbers add up to 15. It never looks inside `a`, `e`, or the objects nested further in.
